profile_text.body:
SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft, according to its own website. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

The site text describes no AI products or services, and no AI products are listed for the company. Its stated business is launch vehicles and spacecraft rather than artificial intelligence.

The company profile lists SpaceX as a for-profit founded in 2002, headquartered in Hawthorne, California, United States, with an organization type of startup. A legal exposure count of 270 is recorded for California.
